title: Wild AG statement window
description: A window-tall band: its top three quarters are a window with a rounded bottom onto footage that stays fixed while the page moves, and under it, on the taupe-to-sand gradient, one giant uppercase line mixing light sans and serif-italic words runs as an endless ticker. The band itself ends in a 73px rounded bottom.
notes: the media slot is fixed to the window; empty, a soft sand placeholder
CSS only; the ticker stands still under reduced motion
